description: Choose which old messages to drop to hit a token target without touching the cached prompt prefix — Given a conversation, the index of the last message inside the provider's cached prefix, and a token target, returns which messages to drop: whole tool call plus tool result pairs (so no result is left without its call) and messages the caller marked droppable, oldest first or largest first, never inside the cached prefix, never the most recent keepRecent messages, never pinned ones. Everything up

cacheBreakpoint.description: Index of the last message inside the cached prefix; -1 when nothing is cached.

keepRecent.description: Most recent messages that are never dropped. Default 4.

messages.description: Up to 500; 400000 characters of content in total.

content.description: Message text, used only to count tokens when tokens is absent.

droppable.description: A text message that may be dropped (tool pairs are droppable by default).

kind.description: tool_call: assistant message holding a tool call; tool_result: its output. Pairs are matched by toolCallId. Default text.

toolCallId.description: Pairs a tool_call with its tool_result.

strategy.description: Order in which droppable units are removed. Default oldest-first.

targetTokens.description: Total tokens to get at or under.

tokenizer.description: o200k_base or cl100k_base. Any other name (including Claude models) returns status unsupported for items that need counting; caller token counts are always accepted.

name: conversation-prune
